title: Austin Considers Great Hills Annexation
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened solely to hold a public hearing regarding the potential full-purpose annexation of the Great Hills area.
*   Residents were invited to share their input on the proposed annexation during the hearing.
*   The public hearing concerning the Great Hills annexation was officially closed with a unanimous 4-0 vote by the attending members.
